brand_tiers._comment: A = buy blind, B = buy after checking, anything absent = ignored. Seeded later by the brand ledger step.

match._comment: gates between a search hit and something you are shown. candidate_min: worth opening the product page for. accept_min: the page confirmed it. inspect_per_store: how many pages to walk into per store.

browser._comment: Shopify Markets and most boutiques price by the requesting IP/locale, and never name the currency. This is the identity the hunter's browser presents, so it decides WHICH market's price you are shown. en-US reads US-market prices; he-IL reads what you would actually pay from Israel, but some stores geo-block or hide stock. Every inspected offer records the locale it was read under.

google._comment: Google Custom Search JSON API — CLOSED to new customers as of 2026 (existing keys valid to 1 Jan 2027). Only fill this in if you already hold a key. Blocked shops are served by agent/archive.py (Common Crawl, keyless) instead. NOT Google Shopping scraping: google.com/robots.txt disallows /search and /shopping/*, and this project honours a Disallow.

read._comment: Which ways of reading a shop are on. Order of trust inside a page is fixed (jsonld > meta > text). shopify_catalog: whole /products.json with sizes. sitemap_index: the shop's own product list. archive: Common Crawl copy of shops that refuse us (weeks old). google: only for holders of a legacy Custom Search key. headed_when_blocked: open the visible Chrome for shops marked needs_headed.
